test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When x is added to each of 17, 9, 26 and 14, then the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. Then, if 8x : y :: y : (4x - 2) , and y > 0 , what is the value of y ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Shortcut formula for x: x = |ad − bc| / |(a + d) − (b + c)|

x = |17 × 14 − 9 × 26| / |(17 + 14) − (9 + 26)| = |238 − 234| / |31 − 35| = 4 / 4 = 1

Given 8x : y :: y : (4x − 2) ⇒ y² = 8x × (4x − 2)

y² = 8(1) × (4(1) − 2) = 8 × 2 = 16 ⇒ y = 4

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers 17, 9, 26, 14; x is added to each; 8x : y :: y : (4x − 2).

**Formula:** If a, b, c, d are in proportion, then a/b = c/d.

 (17 + x) : (9 + x) = (26 + x) : (14 + x) 
• 8x y 4x−2 Mean Proportion: y² = 8x × (4x − 2)

⇒ (17 + x) / (9 + x) = (26 + x) / (14 + x)

⇒ (17 + x)(14 + x) = (26 + x)(9 + x)

⇒ 238 + 17x + 14x + x² = 234 + 26x + 9x + x²

⇒ 238 + 31x = 234 + 35x

⇒ 35x − 31x = 238 − 234

⇒ 4x = 4 ⇒ x = 1

⇒ y² = 8x × (4x − 2)

⇒ y² = 8(1) × (4(1) − 2) = 8 × 2 = 16

⇒ y = √16 = 4

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is √(a × b). If a : y :: y : b, then y is the mean proportional.

Fourth Proportional

If a, b, and c are three numbers, the fourth proportional d is calculated as d = (b × c) / a, such that a : b :: c : d.

Invertendo Property

If a : b :: c : d, then by invertendo, b : a :: d : c. This means if a/b = c/d, then b/a = d/c.
